scenarios.label: 咖啡时间
scenarios.classification: ambiguous umbrella: food receipt / independent backdrop / declared special effect

trigger.value: Accepted pet_feed coffee receipt, or post-commit automatic meal. No autonomous coffee-time trigger established.

visibleState.value: Food ritual shows surprised→hungry→satisfied; this hungry cue is a transient eating phase, not the persisted hunger fact.

actionFace.value: sip-tea sip/cup/steam, total 3500ms (450/850/2200); calm mode only final expression 1600ms. Dango sip raster face override applies when cup contact.

wardrobe.value: Independent persistent wardrobe filtered by form/skin/level/view; explicit itemIds supported; exclusiveGroup resolves highest priority, then level, then z. No audited scenario-specific outfit switch.

temporary.value: cup from action; food drop on accepted receipt; coffee-shop is not linked to this action.

background.value: Outside focus/rest: deterministic local-calendar-date seed + sceneOffset over time-period pool; manual skin preferences only when local day-of-month divisible by 3. Focus/rest overrides with mode room. Docked hides background. Particles stochastic, background identity is not.

exitInterruptPriority.value: interaction 80; replacement/press/menu/disposal/presentation policy cancel sequence+action+owned speech. Finish optionally celebrates and returns latest base.

gaps: coffee status effect renderer accepts coffee but caller only found for hungry; no evidence of coffee-time special-state activation
Need product decision whether coffee_time means actual feeding, ambient sip, or independently selectable scene; do not conflate.
